Q1_timeW_on_a_daily_chart.question: On a 1D chart asking time("W") mid-week: `na`, the FORMING week's open, or the LAST COMPLETED week's open? The three differ on every bar that is not a period boundary.
Q1_timeW_on_a_daily_chart._: ⭐⭐ THE THREE WITNESSES ARE THE PROOF. `timeW` holds CONSTANT at 20704.5625 across three consecutive daily bars while the bar's own time increments by one day each — that is a weekly bar's open standing still while the days advance inside it. ⛔ AND IT RULES OUT THE THIRD ANSWER: the last COMPLETED week would sit 5 to 9 days back; the observed spread is 0 to -4, i.e. inside the current week. ⭐ The 0 case is the week's first bar, where the weekly open IS the daily bar's own time.
Q1_timeW_on_a_daily_chart._consequence: ⛔ `na`-free means the Q4 comparison idiom below is safe — which the backlog said was conditional on exactly this.
